title: feat(sdk/react): generation hooks and a useChat transport
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added five generation hooks to @pollinations/sdk/react: useImageGeneration, useTextGeneration, useAudioGeneration, useVideoGeneration, and useTranscription. Each uses the signed-in key from PolliProvider and returns data, isLoading, error, run, rerun, and cancel. Requests can be cancelled; starting another run aborts the previous one, and only the latest run can update state. Key changes, logout, and unmount abort requests and clear results; a 401 logs the user out. Signed-out runs send no request, and run reports failures through error rather than rejecting. Added usePollinationsChatTransport for Vercel AI SDK useChat, streaming browser requests from /v1/responses with text chunks, usage metadata, and error handling. It maps server-run mcp__* tool calls and outputs, but ignores caller-run functions. The ai package is an optional ^7.0.0 peer dependency with no runtime import. README and changelog coverage were added, alongside 19 new tests.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Give her tiny coding glasses; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a warm cream background.
